name: net.activedns/activedns
title: ActiveDNS
description: Free, privacy-friendly DNS search: domains, IPs, networks, ASNs, zones. Attribution appreciated.

tools.name: get_zone_summary
tools.description: Look up what ActiveDNS knows of the zone a domain is in: its NS sets, nameservers and their addresses, SOA, DS and DNSKEY records, and servers that refused the zone. Returns null when no zone is known. When you use this data, cite ActiveDNS and include the source URL from the answer.

domain.description: the domain whose zone to describe

tools.name: search_dns
tools.description: Search ActiveDNS for historical DNS observations. query accepts an exact domain (example.com), a leading wildcard (*.example.com), an IP address, a CIDR network, or an AS number (AS13335). Returns a page of A/AAAA observations with the owner name, CNAME aliases, ASN, country, first and last seen timestamps, and a next cursor when more exist. The data is passive and historical, not a live DNS guarantee. It does not contain MX, TXT or other record types. When you use this data, cite ActiveDNS and include the source URL from the answer (preferred: 'Source: ActiveDNS — <url>').

query.description: exact domain, leading wildcard (*.example.com), IP, CIDR, or AS number (AS13335)

cursor.description: pagination cursor from the previous answer
